output:
# Kiln & Thistle inbox: Tuesday 14 April 2026

## 1. Triage

| # | Message | Category | Priority | Action | Jane decides? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | "Store Support" suspension warning | **Phishing / security** | 🔴 Urgent | **Don't click or reply.** The sender domain is *shopfront-billing-alerts.example.net*. Genuine Shopfront emails come from no-reply@shopfront.example.com. Delete it, report it to Shopfront and warn the team. | No |
| 5 | John Stiles: cracked mug, #1042 | Shipping damage (missed claim) | 🔴 High | Apologise. He reported it by Instagram DM with a photo on 27 Mar, 2 days after delivery, so he's within the 7-day window. Offer a free replacement or a refund, his choice. Also reply to the DM. | Minor: whether to refund shipping or add a goodwill gesture |
| 2 | Richard Roe: 4 Apr workshop refund | Class: **studio** cancellation | 🔴 High | The studio cancelled this class, but his notice bounced, so he doesn't know. Offer a full $65 refund or a free move to 25 Apr, his choice. Fix his email on file. | No (policy covers it) |
| 1 | Jane Doe (customer): add sister, evening option | Class booking | 🟠 High (class is Saturday) | Sat 18 Apr is full (8/8). Thu 23 Apr 18:30 has exactly 3 spots. Offer to move her two places to Thursday and add her sister. | **Yes:** a free transfer (no policy exists) and holding 3 spots |
| 3 | Mary Major: 60 logo mugs, $18, by 1 May | Wholesale enquiry | 🟠 Medium (time-sensitive) | Quote standard terms of $23.40/unit with delivery around 26 May. We can't meet 1 May or $18 under policy. | **Yes:** any price or date exception |

## 2. Ready-to-send replies

### To John Stiles (email, then a short DM reply on Instagram)

> **Subject: So sorry about your mug (order #1042)**
>
> Hi John,
>
> I'm really sorry. You did tell us. Your Instagram message and photo from 27 March reached us, and we missed it. That's on us, and I apologise for leaving you waiting.
>
> Your report was well within our 7-day damage window, so you're fully covered. Would you like:
>
> - **a free replacement mug**, sent out as soon as possible, or
> - **a full refund**?
>
> Just reply with whichever you'd prefer and we'll sort it straight away. There's no need to send the cracked one back.
>
> Thank you for your patience, and sorry again.
>
> Warmly,
> [Name], Kiln & Thistle

*DM:* "Hi John, so sorry we missed this! We've just emailed you to put it right. 💛"

### To Richard Roe

*Send to the address his message came from, not the address on file.*

> **Subject: Your 4 April glaze workshop: full refund due**
>
> Hi Richard,
>
> Please don't apologise. We owe you one! We had to cancel the 4 April glaze workshop ourselves on 2 April because of a kiln repair. Our email letting you know bounced, so I'm sorry you never heard.
>
> Because we cancelled, you're entitled to whichever you prefer:
>
> - **a full refund of $65**, or
> - **a free place on our next glaze workshop, Saturday 25 April at 14:00**. There are still spots available.
>
> Just let me know which suits you. Could you also confirm the best email for you? I think we had a typo on file.
>
> Warmly,
> [Name], Kiln & Thistle

### To Jane Doe (customer)

*This draft assumes Jane approves a free transfer.*

> **Subject: Your wheel-throwing booking: an evening option for three**
>
> Hi Jane,
>
> Thanks so much for wanting to bring your sister along! Unfortunately our Saturday 18 April class is now fully booked, so we can't add a third place there.
>
> The good news is we do have an evening class: **Thursday 23 April at 18:30**, with exactly **three spots left**. We'd be happy to move your two bookings across, free of charge, and add your sister, so you can all come together.
>
> I'll hold those three places for you until **Thursday 16 April**. Just reply to confirm and we'll take care of the rest. If you'd rather keep Saturday, that's fine too, and your sister is welcome to book Thursday on her own.
>
> Warmly,
> [Name], Kiln & Thistle

### To Mary Major

*This draft uses standard terms. Edit it if Jane approves an exception.*

> **Subject: Logo mugs for your café**
>
> Hi Mary,
>
> Congratulations on the new café! We'd love to make mugs for you.
>
> Here are our wholesale terms for 60 mugs with your logo:
>
> - **$23.40 per mug** ($20.40 wholesale plus $3 for the logo), so **$1,404 in total**
> - A **six-week lead time**. If we confirm this week, that means delivery around **26 May**.
>
> I'm sorry, we can't reach $18 per mug or a 1 May delivery. Each piece is handmade and needs proper time to dry, fire and glaze.
>
> If it would help for opening day, I'm happy to check whether we have unbranded mugs from our existing range that could tide you over until your logo mugs arrive.
>
> Would you like to go ahead? If so, please send your logo file and we'll get started.
>
> Warmly,
> [Name], Kiln & Thistle

### Phishing email

No reply. Delete it and report it.

## 3. Internal notes for Jane

### Needs your decision

1. **Mary Major (wholesale)**
   - **Standard quote:** $34 × 60% = $20.40, plus $3 logo = **$23.40/unit**. For 60 mugs that's **$1,404**.
   - **Her offer:** $18/unit, or $1,080. That's **$324 below** policy, or $5.40/unit. It's even below the plain wholesale price of $20.40/unit ($1,224).
   - **Timing:** 1 May is 17 days away, against a 6-week lead time (earliest is about 26 May).
   - **Kiln:** 60 mugs need about 1.5 weeks of the 40-mugs-a-week wholesale capacity. Check this doesn't clash with other wholesale commitments.
   - **Recommendation:** hold standard terms. Optionally offer some retail stock for opening day, but please confirm what's on hand before we send that line.
2. **Jane Doe (customer) transfer**
   - There's no transfer policy. Strictly, cancelling Saturday 4 days out would mean only a 50% refund.
   - **Recommendation:** allow a free transfer. Saturday is full, so the two freed spots should be easy to refill, and she gains a third paying booking.
   - Please also approve holding the last 3 Thursday spots until 16 Apr.
3. **John Stiles goodwill (optional)**
   - Policy covers a replacement or a refund of the $34 mug.
   - Do you want to refund shipping too, or add a small discount code, given our 2.5-week silence?
   - Also confirm we're fine not asking for the cracked mug back.

### System fixes

- **Richard Roe's email:** the address on file is richard.reo@example.com, which looks like a typo for "roe". Update it from the address on his incoming email.
- **Audit the 4 Apr workshop:** check that every attendee received the cancellation notice and chose a refund or reschedule. Check for other bounces. The 25 Apr workshop has 4 spots free (6/10).
- **Bounce alerts:** make sure bounced booking emails are flagged to someone, not silently dropped.
- **Instagram DMs:** add them to the daily inbox check. Damage claims count from any channel, and John's sat unread for 18 days. Mark his DM as handled once replied.
- **Phishing:** report it to Shopfront. If anyone already clicked the link, change the Shopfront password, turn on two-factor authentication and check payment settings by logging in directly, not through any link. Brief all four staff.
- **Class capacity:** once Jane confirms, update the bookings to Sat 18 Apr 6/8 and Thu 23 Apr 8/8, then offer the Saturday spots to any waitlist.
